Phrased differently, this implies that any property of Boolean functions which admits a (k, q)-round-adaptive tester also has a (0, 2q − 1)-round-adaptive tester. In this section, we make this parallel rigorous, and give a blackbox reduction between the two that one can leverage to establish lower bounds on k-round-adaptive testing.
